# Course Reference Instructions

These instructions are for providing assistance with the code examples used in the OpenAI Agents SDK course. When users ask for help related to these examples, refer to the relevant sections below to guide them effectively.

## Course Module Reference

When assisting users, identify the specific course module they are working on. Each module has its own set of learning objectives, documentation links, time estimates, prerequisites, steps, key concepts, verification methods, and common issues.

### Reference Files

For each course module, refer to the corresponding README and article files located in the `.course/` directory. These files contain detailed instructions and code references that can help users troubleshoot and understand the material.

- `.course/module-[moduleNumber]/README.md` - Contains learning objectives, documentation links, steps, key concepts, verification methods, and common issues.
- `.course/module-[moduleNumber]/code-reference.md` - Contains code snippets and structure to follow for implementation.
